description:
Back To The Light? Woe Unto Them That Call Light For Darkness!

In Episode 221 we discuss the death of Pope Francis. During his reign he swung the pendulum to the woke, liberal side by seemingly embracing controversial aspects such as same sex marriages, banning the Latin mass and embracing non-Christian religions. Will this trend be halted and even reversed by a new Pope? Will pre Vatican II traditional Catholicism raise its head again? Statistics show that young people are embracing traditional Catholicism and joining the Catholic Church in droves. They want a pre Vatican 2 church - out with the new, back to the old. Woe unto them that call light for darkness and darkness light.
